A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MICS, MMRP, and Chiron-o1 research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–H support reliable comparison despite the changed title, pagination, and figure numbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original Chiron-o1 evaluations, training-data and curriculum ablations, and generated medical reasoning examples in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results and adds baseline comparisons in Table 1 and 2B curriculum-ablation results in Figure 5(b).

M1.justification: The mentor–intern search, MICS-Score, path selection, stopping rules, and three-stage training procedure are unchanged. Figure 2 now explicitly depicts images as intern inputs, but these inputs already appeared in v1 Equation 3 and the appendix prompt.

E1.justification: The MMRP subsets, imaging modalities, clinical scenarios, supplementary training datasets, and seven evaluation benchmarks are retained. The added baseline and 2B ablation results use existing tasks and datasets.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds Gemini-2.5-Pro and ChestX-Reasoner. Existing comparators remain, including Med-Flamingo despite its omission from the revised baseline-description examples. The Gemini Pro row is relabeled Gemini-1.5-Pro, retaining its four previously reported benchmark scores.

E3.justification: Figure 5(b) extends the controlled comparison of Stage 1, Stage 1+2, Stage 3, and the complete curriculum to the 2B model; v1 reported this experiment for 8B only. Existing benchmark metrics and stated training hyperparameters remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The new 2B training-stage ablation tests whether the curriculum benefit also holds at the smaller model size. Existing 8B ablations, MICS-versus-vanilla path-trend analysis, training-set comparisons, subdomain analysis, and appendix case studies are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports benchmark seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The additional results continue the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 1 adds Gemini-2.5-Pro and ChestX-Reasoner results, averaging 68.8 and 59.1 respectively. The renamed Gemini-1.5-Pro row gains a PMC-VQA score of 52.3, changing its average from 62.8 over four benchmarks to 60.7 over five. Figure 5(b) adds 2B stage-ablation results. Existing Chiron-o1 benchmark scores and appendix results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–9, including the MICS-Score, mentor competitiveness, training objective, and dataset-construction definitions, are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about MICS, MMRP, curriculum-trained Chiron-o1, and generalizable medical reasoning performance. The new title explicitly names the model and search strategy without changing these contributions.

C2.justification: The explanations of MICS effectiveness, curriculum benefits, and clinical-task performance are retained, as are Appendix E's computational-cost and dataset-scale limitations. The additional general-model comparison in Section 4.2 reports comparative performance without introducing a new mechanism explanation or applicability boundary.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 newly discloses eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs, DeepSpeed ZeRO-1, and stage durations of approximately 12, 12, and 48 hours. The abstract changes prospective code release to stated availability. These are documentation additions; the PDFs do not establish a change to the underlying implementation.

R1.justification: v2 adds seven references, including Gemini 2.5, ChestX-Reasoner, DeepSpeed, and works on few-shot and graph-based reasoning. Section 2 modestly expands its discussion of these reasoning approaches while retaining the original research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 retitles the paper, updates the conference header, adds acknowledgments, and revises limited passages in related work, implementation details, and ablation discussion. The overall narrative and section structure remain substantially intact; appendix content matches apart from renumbering.

P2.justification: Figure 2 explicitly adds intern image inputs. v1 Figure 4 is separated into v2 Figure 4 and Figure 5(a), with a new 2B panel in Figure 5(b). Table 1 gains rows and revised ranking highlights, while other figures are repositioned or renumbered.

improvement.justification: The added baselines and 2B curriculum ablation modestly strengthen empirical validation, while hardware/software disclosures and stated code availability improve reproducibility information. These benefits are tempered by the new claim that Chiron-o1 'easily surpasses' general models despite Gemini-2.5-Pro leading two Table 1 benchmarks, and ambiguous accounting of '72 GPU-hours' alongside eight GPUs and 72 hours of stage durations. The net gain is limited but supported.
